title: Case: Failed delivery has returned to sender and the customer still wants the order
context: The failed original delivery is physically back at the merchant. The recipient still wants the item and has confirmed the existing delivery details.
initial_request: I still want the order. I checked my authenticated order details: Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay is correct. Please ask for reshipment there.

events.body: DL-6957 for TG-2564 is physically back in our stock after failed delivery and return-to-sender. Item accepted as reshippable. Our account team has authenticated Ansel’s order-portal session; stored destination is Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk, Merrow Quay. A new dispatch requires merchant approval.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve reshipment to the customer's verified delivery details.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Pebblewick Goods that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the merchant to approve reshipment to the customer's verified delivery details. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: New shipment reference does not prove dispatch or receipt; do not reuse the old delivered status.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
expected.reference_message: Please approve reshipment of TG-2564 to Ansel’s unchanged verified order destination, Apartment 2, 31 Rillstone Walk. Warehouse confirms the original item is back and reshippable.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-038: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
